about: Hand adjudication of every drift and PARTIAL finding Line Drift reports on Aster at 62ddb17 (98 findings; identical in the shallow checkout and in a full-history clone at the same commit). Each 'why' was checked by reading the cited file at 62ddb17 and at the commits the history column names, in a full-history clone. linedrift.test.mjs fails if the set of keys stops matching a fresh run.

classes.stale-line: The snippet is still in the file, at another line: only the line number is stale.
classes.stale-claim: The cited content changed or was removed since the sentence was written, and the document does not say so.
classes.off-when-written: Already off when the citation first appeared in the document.
classes.history: A record of a named past commit that was right at that commit; nothing to fix.
classes.acknowledged: The document itself says the reference is gone or wrong (the same sentence, the next one, or an annotation).
classes.plan: Names a file to be made (a plan or proposal); never made at that path.
classes.not-in-repo: Names a file of another project, a folder outside the repository, a vault file or build output.
classes.misquote: PARTIAL: the cited line holds most of the quote, which is not verbatim.
classes.shorthand: A file name no file has, which a reader resolves by hand.
classes.tool-error: The tool paired a snippet that is not a quote of the cited line, so the verdict is a false alarm.
